messages.author: priyasarwar
messages.content:
I am currently enrolled in the IITM BS RSAians Vinternship batch, which has already started. Recently, I also received a mail stating that since I am enrolled in the NPTEL Professor Course, I am eligible for the AKSians Vinternship batch and that I will receive the internship offer after completing 20% of the course.

I am a bit confused about whether RSAians and AKSians are part of the same Vinternship track or different batches. I would like to understand which batch I should actively follow to ensure my internship confirmation.

messages.author: nitin_fighter1379
messages.content: Since you're already a part of the RSAins batch, please proceed on with it.

messages.author: priyasarwar
messages.content: What about the internship offer letter? Will I get it after completing 20% of the RSAins batch?

messages.author: nitin_fighter1379
messages.content: It will be informed in due time over announcements. For now, you can continue with the ViBe progress.
